name: Yash Chemex Limited
about: Yash Chemex Limited, together with its subsidiary, Yasons Chemex Care Limited, trades in chemical products in India. The company also manufactures and sells dyes and intermediates; and FMCG products, including hand sanitizers, hair oil, soap, perfumes, deodrants, etc. Yash Chemex Limited was founded in 1990 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
